skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand key historical events related to the Vietnam Communist Party.
Recognize the role of the Party in leading and developing the country.
Develop systematic understanding of historical knowledge about the Party's leadership, struggle, and governance.
Foster national pride and a sense of responsibility for the future of the nation among young generations.
Develop research, analysis, synthesis, and generalization skills related to the history of the Party.
Practice independent work and teamwork skills.
Possess the ability to self-study and find materials to complete assignments.
